title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hi, I'm Diana, General Counsel at Jane, where I'm lucky to work with smart and empathetic people who care deeply about helping the helpers — the healthcare community that helps all of us. This team is all about fostering growth and spreading delight, and as an added plus, Jane is a remote-first company, meaning every role at Jane, including this one, is remote, giving you the freedom to work from any corner of Canada.

We're looking for an experienced lawyer to join us as Senior Counsel, taking a hands-on approach to legal work at Jane, where we believe legal done right can delight. You'll join the small and mighty Legal team, alongside Jane's General Counsel and Senior Legal & Operations Specialist. You'll work closely with leaders and teams across Jane, including our Product, Partnerships, People, Marketing, and Finance teams. You'll advise on a wide range of legal issues, including commercial contracts, healthcare and privacy regulation, litigation risk, employment law, and corporate governance. There's no expectation you'll come in the door with expertise in all of these areas, but you should have high confidence in a good number of them, along with the willingness and ability to build expertise in the rest.

This role will engage your ability to solve complex problems while working with a collaborative team across Jane in a fast-paced environment. The right person for this role understands people, is smart, creative, and detail-oriented, but also highly practical; someone who can balance risk and get things done.

What Impact We’re Looking for You to Make

  • Provide knowledgeable, practical, helpful legal advice in a fast-paced environment operating globally (including across Canada, the U.S., and the U.K.), enabling Jane to improve our customers' experience, shorten review timelines, and ship faster and better.

  • Identify legal solutions as well as risks — take ownership and identify paths for the team to succeed.

  • Review, negotiate, and advise on commercial agreements (MSAs, partnership agreements, vendor terms, NDAs, BAAs, and more), and advise on employment law, litigation risk, and strategy — including drafting and updating templates as our needs evolve.

  • Handle law enforcement and regulatory requests (subpoenas, warrants, regulatory inquiries), and advise on IP protection and brand enforcement.

  • Build collaborative relationships across Jane, working hand-in-hand with developers, product owners, and others to build products and experiences that delight.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, explaining legal impact in practical, real-world terms that matter to other Janers.

  • Help build and scale Legal's AI environment — from automated intake to contract review and document management — so the team can grow without slowing down.

  • Mentor others on the team and across Jane, supporting their development and understanding of the law.

What Experience We Need

  • 7+ years as a practicing lawyer, including in-house experience advising high-growth technology companies.

  • Called to the bar in Canada (Ontario or BC preferred); US bar admission is an asset. Other global bar admissions and experience are also valued and welcomed.

  • Established expertise in at least 3 of the following areas, with the ability and commitment to strengthen expertise in the others: commercial contracts, privacy regulation, healthcare regulation, litigation risk, employment law, and corporate governance.

  • Proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills, comfortable working with cross-functional teams and able to explain complicated things simply and clearly.

  • A true advisor who builds strong relationships and communicates effectively, making an impact on outcomes.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize across multiple tasks.

  • Demonstrates ethical integrity and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

  • Comfortable using AI and technology in your legal work, including in contract review and legal research.

  • Ideally, experience building and owning legal processes and products — for example, end-to-end NDA review using AI, or knowledge management processes.

  • Ideally, experience working with scaling companies or other entrepreneurial environments, spanning multiple jurisdictions including Canada and the US. Other global experience is also valued and welcomed.

If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $158,400 - $247,500. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of $198,000. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
